response.overview: Callisto and Bianca, best friends who’ve trained together in Antarctica, have been sent to join a terraforming mission on the planet Venus. When their ship malfunctions, they end up stranded on an alien planet and must navigate unknown terrain, bird-like people, and strangely familiar creatures.
response.tagline: Two terraformers end up stranded on an alien planet and must navigate unknown terrain, bird-like people, and strangely familiar creatures.
response.title: Project Gaia
